At source 1.00s she drops her shoulder and makes one sharp lateral deke, just outside his fingers. He commits his weight to the missed grab; his planted boot skids on the damp stone. His single tail sweeps opposite his hips in an unsuccessful counterbalance. Taffy waits for Harper, watchful rather than idle. Keep his portly build, large ears and plum clothing. Behind the upper ledge screen, he lowers his head and shoulders a little, keeps most of his body concealed and peers around the blue pipe toward the approach; one small glance checks the other direction, then he settles back into cover without leaving. Below, the pipe fitter concentrates on a stubborn fitting. Water visibly bubbles through the existing runoff channel. A small intermittent jet spits from the joint she is adjusting; she recoils just a little, gives the leak an annoyed look and deliberately tightens the fitting with her tool. The spray diminishes to a dribble as she checks her work. During source 1.00–3.33s overlap Taffy’s discreet lookout with her spray–irritation–adjustment beat. Keep the frame quiet and spatially clear: steady wide composition with only a very slight inward drift. She is attending to maintenance, not helping or noticing Taffy.
